description: Use this to read one pose before using it: its description word for word (the text a mention sends with the mannequin picture), shelf, difficulty, what carries the body, props, and every mannequin picture by figure (woman, man) and place on the Camera Angles globe: the pose's own pictures and the views members made, each with its place in words and numbers ("Back left · from above", azimuth 225, elevation 30) and the mention that asks for that view ("@barry in @seiza_pose.back"). The woman or man mannequin is picked automatically from the character's gender. When the angle the user wants is missing, make_pose_view makes it. Free.

handle.description: The pose's handle, with or without the @ (e.g. "sitting_knee_up_pose"), from search_poses. An angle suffix (".side") is fine.
